method: Madden OVR movement >= 2 is sole recurring player rating review trigger. One-time first-cycle current EA/HQ gap QA is additional historical triage, not recurring player-review trigger. Coach reviews are mandatory 32/32 biweekly.
historicalBaselineCaveat: EA archived Week 3 to October 27 produced 300 HQ candidates, not a certified October 3 snapshot. Original 120/575 October 2-3 observation unrecovered.

changes.subject: Dalton Kincaid
changes.reason: 2026 through Week 7: PFF 72.8 overall, 12th/30 qualifying TEs; 23/29 for 315 yards, one touchdown and zero drops. Clearly a high-end receiving option, but 91 is an elite complete-TE tier not yet sustained relative to LaPorta, Kraft and veteran peers.

changes.subject: Dallas Goedert
changes.reason: 2026 PFF 76.2 overall (6th/30 TEs), 79.2 receiving (5th/30) with no drops; still reliable route and catch-point utility. Restricted 180 receiving yards and age 31 cap a modest +2 rather than a major reversion to peak.

changes.subject: Jessie Bates III
changes.reason: 2026 PFF 81.4 overall (6th/93 safeties), 82.5 coverage (4th/93), 472 snaps through Week 7 plus sustained high-level track record. Meaningful upgrade while limited run-grade and target results prevent a 94-style superstar copy of Madden.

changes.subject: Jalen Pitre
changes.reason: PFF 76.5 overall (13th/93 safeties) and 77.0 coverage (8th/93), 2026 through Week 7; elite slot/safety versatility remains, but current 94 implies sustained near-ceiling all-phase defense unsupported by present play. Remains very good at 91.

changes.subject: Todd Monken
changes.reason: 5-2 first-year Cleveland start, identifiable offensive installation and improving run-game design (183 rushing yards and 3 TD vs Tennessee in Week 7) despite five new offensive linemen. One-point gain only due to short HC sample.

changes.subject: Klint Kubiak
changes.reason: After an initial 3-0 start, four straight losses with persistent third-down/red-zone issues and uneven personnel/scheme adjustments. Own acknowledged game-management miscues; small downgrade without discarding his offensive pedigree.

changes.subject: John Harbaugh
changes.reason: 4-2-1 Giants reset shows tangible staff construction, leadership and tailored offense across multiple QB changes; NFL's October 27 account documents staff adaptations and player accountability. One point above Ryans, still below Jim Harbaugh's 90 tier.

held: Remaining flagged players retain existing grades pending individual evidence, rather than being declared reviewed and cleared.
development: On publication, each player whose HQ grade changed must be reevaluated through existing post-ratings workflow; no automatic probability edits.
coachReview: All 32 received a preliminary desk assessment in PR #2254; this cycle changes 3 with confirmed additional reasons. Remaining coaches stay under full biweekly review.
